name: prefix constructor
source:
theorem t (p q : Prop) (hp : p) (hq : q) : p ∧ q := by
  constructor

name: after constructor
source:
theorem t (p q : Prop) (hp : p) (hq : q) : p ∧ q := by
  constructor
  · exact hp
  · exact hq

name: inside exact
source:
theorem t (p q : Prop) (hp : p) (hq : q) : p ∧ q := by
  constructor
  · exact hp
  · exact hq

name: induction cases
source:
theorem t (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp

name: have block
source:
example (a b : Nat) (h : a = b) : b = a := by
  have h2 : b = a := h.symm
  exact h2

name: unicode
source:
theorem αβ (α : Prop) (h : α) : α ∨ False := by
  left
  exact h

name: error recovery
source:
example (p : Prop) (hp : p) : p ∧ p := by
  constructor
  exact hq
  exact hp
